note: INTERNAL ONLY. Every provider value below is an exact identifier already recorded in docs/technical/GridView_Provider_Evaluation.md section 8. Matching is byte-for-byte: no case folding, trimming, slugging, transliteration or similarity search is ever applied. Targets are read from the curated GridView registries and are never minted from a provider name. These values must never appear in a public API fixture, response, OpenAPI example or published snapshot. Dormant: no adapter consumes this registry yet.

mappings.evidence: GridView_Provider_Evaluation.md 8.5 - session_result position 1 carries driver_number 1 and joins to Jolpica's Norris on 25 points over 70 laps.
mappings.note: Season-qualified deliberately. Number 1 is the reigning champion's per-season choice and is reassigned between seasons (8.7 M2), so it can never be a cross-season key.
